name: com.playtradex.sdk
description:
Native blockchain SDK for Unity games and applications.

• Multi-network EVM blockchain integration
• Multiple configurable RPC endpoints per network
• Built-in EVM testnet presets
• Multi-wallet support with PlayTradeX identity and external wallets
• Developer-defined network and wallet IDs
• Generated network and wallet constants
• Centralized configuration through Unity Project Settings
• Native wallet creation and platform-specific secure storage
• Native currency balance queries and transactions
• Network-aware smart contract read and write operations
• Application-controlled transaction consent and approval flow
• Transaction preparation and simulation information
• Encrypted wallet export and import
• Android Keystore and Storage Access Framework integration
• Exact string-based blockchain unit conversion
• ABI conversion and Unity Editor tooling
• SDK About and update tooling
• Asynchronous operations with Unity main-thread callback dispatch
• Unity integration sample with network and wallet selection
• Windows x64 and Android arm64-v8a support

samples.description:
Complete PlayTradeX SDK 0.2.0-alpha integration sample for Unity.

• SDK initialization and readiness handling
• Configured multi-network selection
• PlayTradeX identity and external wallet selection
• Native wallet and address operations
• Network-aware native balance queries
• Native currency transactions using selected networks and wallets
• Network-aware smart contract read operations
• Smart contract writes using identity or configured external wallets
• Transaction preparation, simulation, consent and approval flow
• Exact blockchain unit conversion
• Wallet export and import
• Android wallet backup and restore workflow
• Generated network and wallet identifier usage
• Blockchain response and error handling
